multi_entity_note: Many Athene and Apollo entities sign as joint filers.
processing_note: In accordance with Rule 13d-1(k) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, the undersigned hereby confirm the agreement by and among them to the joint filing on behalf of them of the Statement on Schedule 13D and any and all further amendments thereto, with respect to the securities of the above referenced issuer, and that this Agreement be included as an Exhibit to such filing.

contract.document_name.rationale: The document is titled Joint Filing Agreement (preceded by the exhibit label Exhibit D).

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The undersigned execute the agreement as of July 6, 2020.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The only date is the as-of execution date, July 6, 2020, which is the date the agreement takes effect.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement states no term or expiration date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: The agreement has no governing law clause.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement has no renewal provision.

contract.notice_period.rationale: The agreement has no renewal or non-renewal notice provision.
